svg.title: Figure 1: the gate ladder for a dedicated PDP root-finder, with the two tracks' boundaries and reference arms
svg.text: Gate ladder for a dedicated PDP root-finder (README section 6)
one instance shape (K, E, V, m), targets x_R, every arm on the same frozen corpus, counted units, wall time as a note
once per (E, V, m): charged as T_prepare
per target, K in lock-step: T_target

g.text: G0 exactness
digests equal the exhaustive reference; every witness verified in the group
G1 vs the enumeration floor T_enum
work / T_enum below 1 and falling (at most 0.6x per rung) over 4+ rungs
G2 vs F4 / F5 / general Groebner (the requested gate)
(a) at most 0.1x the best Groebner arm at the largest cell both finish
(b) lower growth beta, disjoint 95% intervals, 4+ sizes; (c) not slower than msolve
G3 vs the generic line (the only exponent gate)
beta below the pair table's floor(m/2)/m bits per variable at poly(N) memory
G4 vs SAT (binary only)
fewer decisions than WDSat and the native CDCL+XOR; decides n = 59, l = 9
G5 amortised accounting
(S, T_prepare, T_target, K) and log2(S T^2) - log2(r/|Aut|) per rung
G6 end-to-end admissibility (m at least 4)
ECC2K-130: T_target below ~2^35 group ops at m = 4 (Macaulay degree 2)
256-bit prime: T_dec below ~2^59 at m = 4 (degree 3); then ecbench verdict
G7 classification
advance (G3 passed), engineering (G1, G2a), relabelling, accounting
Binary track: F_(2^n), n prime
V an F2-subspace (dim l) or a Frobenius-stable set
Floors (derived)
T_enum = 2^((m-1)l) / (m-1)!, O(l) field ops each
pair table: 2^(floor(m/2) l) at 2^(ceil(m/2) l) memory
product law: beat own enumeration by 2^-(63.2 + log2 m)
Reference arms (measured)
R1 pairs-and-solve: 338 to 452 ns per pair, l = 8..12
R2 mitm: n = 59, l = 9 in 3.86 core-s, 80/80 verdicts
R3 inherited F4 / F6-IC, matrix-F4/F5, wide solver
R4 WDSat, CryptoMiniSat, native CDCL+XOR
R5 msolve, Singular, PolyBoRi (Magma scripts, not run)
R8 F4 trace replay: to build; ceiling 4.3% of the rows
What F4 does today
solving degree 7 at m = 3 (l = 4 and 5)
2^8.6 to 2^9.3 per rung of l; enumeration 2^2, table 2^1
SAT visits 2^(3l)/3! nodes: enumeration with overhead
Obstruction to beat
no Frobenius-stable subspace at prime n;
deciding degree about l/2 on the full descent
Budget at n = 131 (derived, README 6.4)
m = 3: dead at the linear algebra (5 K^2 = 2^75)
m = 4: l = 34, T_target below 2^35, T_enum = 2^99
m = 5: l = 28, T_target below 2^41
admissible Macaulay degree 2; measured 7
unit: group-operation equivalents (ecbench gae)
Prime track: F_p
V = L^-1(c), L a tower: Kummer, Dickson, 2-isogeny
Floors (derived)
T_enum = 2^((m-1)t) / (m-1)! (tower-exhaustive)
pair table: 2^(floor(m/2) t); family law S = 0.75 r^(1/6)
family floor r^(2/(m+1)): at or above rho for m = 2, 3
Reference arms (measured)
R6 tower-exhaustive, mitm, subtract (prime-tower base)
R7 f4_fp_tower (f4_fp at msolve parity; sig_fp_tower)
R5 msolve, Singular on exported tower systems
R8 F4 trace replay: to build; at most 58% zero rows
What F4 does today (Kummer towers, p1)
1.6 / 2.1 / 2.4 bits of work per tower variable
enumeration 0.50 to 0.75, pair table 0.33 to 0.50
F5/GVW criteria: D_sig above D, 1.7 to 28x memory
Obstruction to beat
one generator on a 2^N-point grid (no conjugates):
XL degree at least d + delta_Z, delta_Z about N (Prop. 2)
Budget at 256 bits (derived, README 6.4)
m = 3: never below rho (ties only at T_dec = O(1))
m = 5: |F| = 2^52, T_dec below 2^76
admissible Macaulay degree 3 (m = 4); measured 7
N = m t = 256 to 265 tower variables
unit: F_p multiply-adds (ns_per_fp_muladd calibration)

svg.text: arm, cell, work/target, /T_enum, /pair table, /best Groebner, beta (95%), memory, verified, class
Only a G3 pass is an advance; G1 and G2 passes are engineering. Nothing in this figure is measured by this document.
Every number is quoted from a cited artefact or derived in the README.
